name: xtra400 grain
format: Little-endian Float32: G[0:768] at i*3+c, K[768:3072] at 768+i*9+row*3+col (row=exposure, col=density), cell_um[3072], version=3[3073], zero padding[3074:3076]; i=0..255 at e_n=i/255.
frame: 135 film; long side = min(36, 24 × long/short) mm
calibration: Fitted to grain statistics (Lab standard deviations and pixel autocorrelation) measured on flat patches in reference renderings.
exception: Accepted exception: -3 EV rho(1) difference 0.09235086119 (ordinary limit 0.08, accepted limit 0.13); -2 EV rho(1) difference 0.09627138448 (ordinary limit 0.08, accepted limit 0.13); -1 EV rho(1) difference 0.09152437707 (ordinary limit 0.08, accepted limit 0.13); +0 EV rho(1) difference 0.08309522148 (ordinary limit 0.08, accepted limit 0.13); +1 EV rho(1) difference 0.08140645149 (ordinary limit 0.08, accepted limit 0.13); F: floor_phi reaches its accepted upper bound 1.
